verdicts.evidence: The hero says "Up to 40% off through Sunday." and the four cards under "Popular this week" show only single plain prices ($34, $89, $52, $68), with no struck-through price, percentage or sale tag.
Each of the four cards has a flat tinted block with a pale rounded rectangle in the middle and no product photo.
The hero has only the headline, the subhead and the tilted blue SALE badge, with no button or link; "Sale" is the last item in the grey nav.
The tilted saturated-blue badge at the right of the hero has red "SALE" lettering at a similar lightness to the blue, and it is the only saturated colour on the page.
The header has only the "Marlowe & Finch" wordmark and the Kitchen, Bedroom, Garden and Sale links, with no search, cart or account.
